# Shahin Ghanizadeh

> Official bilingual portfolio of Shahin Ghanizadeh, a Senior Technical Product Manager focused on AI products.

Persian name: شاهین غنی‌زاده

Current work: product foundation for a compliance-first AI voice platform in the UAE; operation of Apex, a live AI market-analysis product.
